t: Automated Brand Filtering & Async Title Fetching in GAPalyzer Distillation
s: This technical entry details the refactoring of a Jupyter notebook cell into a Python function for automated competitor title fetching and keyword filter generation within the GAPalyzer SEO tool. It emphasizes code robustness and notebook simplification.
sub: Asynchronous HTTP requests for web scraping
Pandas DataFrame manipulation for data merging
Dynamic keyword filter generation from domain names and titles
Refactoring notebook logic into reusable Python functions
